summary: Retest of iteration_2. Backend suite: 23/23 passed (no change). Browser checks: 4 passed, 1 failed (same pre-existing focus-management bug in AI dialogue open flow, unresolved since iteration_2 - not fixed by main agent yet).

checks.criterion: Deal Highlights is a real rendered preview rather than placeholder text
checks.name: deal-highlights-renders-real-preview
checks.evidence: Re-run passed: deal-highlights-render visible with product, pair, >=3 key terms, benefit, and risk all populated.

checks.criterion: Deal Highlights stays synchronized with Deal Inputs
checks.name: deal-highlights-sync-with-inputs
checks.evidence: Re-run passed: notional edit and dynamic field edit reflected immediately in highlights; product switch to Accumulator updated product/benefit text.

checks.criterion: Full Termsheet and Deal Highlights tabs both work
checks.name: termsheet-and-highlights-tabs-switch
checks.evidence: Re-run passed: tab switch toggles chip text and rendered panel correctly both directions.

checks.criterion: Open AI dialogue works from the embedded AI guidance card
checks.name: open-ai-dialogue-from-guidance-card
checks.evidence: Re-run failed identically to iteration_2: dialogue opens visibly (aria-hidden/aria-expanded correct) but expect(page.locator('#aiNote')).toBeFocused() times out after 5000ms - activeElement remains the trigger button, not #aiNote (ai-advisor-note-input). Screenshot: open-ai-dialogue-from-guidance-card-failure.png. Same root cause reported previously (els.note.focus() overridden by default post-click button focus) - not yet fixed.

checks.criterion: The fixed workflow has no duplicate interactive test identifiers or browser errors
checks.name: workflow-unique-testids-no-console-errors
checks.evidence: Re-run passed: no duplicate testids across DOM, zero console errors, zero >=400 network responses during full tab-switch + AI dialogue open/close workflow.

bugs.criterion: Open AI dialogue works from the embedded AI guidance card
bugs.description: Unresolved from iteration_2: openPopup() in demo/app.js calls els.note.focus() synchronously inside the click handler, but the browser's default focus-the-clicked-button behavior (which fires after the handler) overrides it, so focus lands back on the 'Open AI dialogue' trigger button instead of the advisor note textarea (#aiNote).
bugs.evidence: run_browser_script 'open-ai-dialogue-from-guidance-card' (re-run): expect(page.locator('#aiNote')).toBeFocused() failed, 'Received: inactive', after 5000ms. Dialogue visibly open and correctly rendered per screenshot - confirms this is purely a focus-management defect, not a render defect.

action_items.item: Still open from iteration_2: defer els.note.focus() to the next tick (requestAnimationFrame or setTimeout 0) inside openPopup() in demo/app.js so it isn't overridden by the browser's default button-focus-after-click behavior.

notes: No code changes were detected for the AI dialogue focus bug between iteration_2 and this retest - identical failure signature.
All other criteria remain solid on re-run: highlights render/sync, tab switching, and no-duplicate-testid/no-console-error workflow.
Backend suite (23 tests) re-run clean, no regressions.
